skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit Amiya wears most often. The size of the coat indicates it belonged to someone else.
It has been fixed a couple of times, but it still shows signs of wear.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content: The outfit Amiya wears most often. The size of the coat indicates it belonged to someone else. Despite that, the meticulous repairs she's done on it makes it look as good as new.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
This coat needs to be mended,
and the wounds still need to heal.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content: Black particles have formed her vambrace. People with the knowledge may recognize it as one part of an ancient king's armor.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Threads of melancholy lie scattered across the ribbons, interweaving with the longing and hope spilling from her heart.
Her skirt seared by sorrow and the crown atop her head showcase her firm faith. She has prepared herself for this.

skins.name: Newsgirl
skins.content:
LIMITED EDITION
Test Collection/Newsgirl. Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials and contains carefully-sewn details. An extra custom-made letter opener is included.
skins.quote: The sky of Londinium is always gray.

skins.name: Fresh Fastener
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Fresh Fastener. An outfit worn by Amiya while working for a Rhodes Island restaurant. This poofy coat is cold-resistant, and has enough room to hold something penguin-sized.
skins.quote: The mysterious shopkeeper signed a dream-like agreement with the young lass, Amiya, hoping that she would be able to deliver love and piping-hot food to every customer.

skins.name: Seedsower
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Seedsower. A loose yet comfortable outdoors fit. Comes with an exclusive miniature mountain-grade rucksack and an agricultural nursery kit. The designer has one small wish of her own, and hopes that we can all help to realize it.

skins.name: Solo Around The World
skins.content: Test Birthday Collection 1101/Solo Around The World. The Ark cradling the cocoon of dreams sailed into the galaxy, dissolving into millions of threads. With love as their needle, the many hands crafted a one-of-a-kind garment for Amiya. The remaining threads, intertwined with wishes, were fashioned into a violin.
skins.quote: She draws the bow slowly, gently whispering her wishes. Though not a single note has ever changed, her audience, her stage, and she herself have been constantly evolving. She will not stop playing, until this land and sky hold her music in their memory.

skins.name: In A Myriad of Universes
skins.content: Test Collection Series/In A Myriad of Universes. A journey of pursuit embarked upon by Amiya. Perhaps uncontrolled Originium destroys an entire world, but across countless universes, she will ultimately find you, find hope.
skins.quote: 'Doctor, time still flows as I move forward. I don't yet know what the outcome will be, but I trust that with you, we will reach the most perfect one.'
